name: AI Agents Map
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Your AI setup on one map: coding agents with plan, limits and usage, local LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Jan, KoboldCpp) and their models, MCP servers and skills. Setup installs, updates and signs in everything; connect by drawing a line, with preview and Undo. Batteries show limits, local LLMs get a stop button. New: subagents on their own map, arrows when one agent starts another, API cost in $ or € with a day's limit, and Goose. 8 languages.
